_doc: Model routing for Codex agents. The lead picks a tier per WP with a '- Model: <tier>' line in the WP spec; follow-up messages (tell.sh) resume the same thread on the same model so the cached prompt is reused. Escalate a tier only with a reason in the WP.

light.label: Light
light.use: mechanical work: lint/format, renames, docs, small well-specified fixes

standard.label: Standard
standard.use: typical implementation: new module, endpoint, tests, UI in a known pattern

deep.label: Deep
deep.use: careful work: parsing/algorithms, data correctness, multi-file changes

peak.label: Peak
peak.use: rare: architecture drafts, deep debugging, work that failed twice; needs a reason in the WP

claude_tiers._doc: Claude subagents (engine: claude) run through the lead's Agent tool.
